ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, A, C, D are on the same horizontal straight line, E is directly below C, and line segment EC vertically connects C and E. Ray CB is located inside angle ACE, dividing the angle from CA to CE into two small angles: angle 2 is between AC and CB, and angle 1 is between CB and CE. Reasoning: Because EC is the altitude of triangle AED, EC is perpendicular to AD. Also because AC is a part of AD, ∠ACE = 90°. Angle 1 and angle 2 exactly make up ∠ACE, therefore m∠1 + m∠2 = 90°. Substitute the known values: (2x + 7) + (3x + 13) = 90, obtaining 5x + 20 = 90, so 5x = 70, x = 14. Thus m∠2 = 3x + 13 = 3(14) + 13 = 42 + 13 = 55.

raw_record.question_text: If $\overline{EC}$ is an altitude of $\triangle AED$, $m\angle 1 = 2x + 7$, and $m\angle 2 = 3x + 13$, find $m\angle 2$.

method.method_draft: Read the diagram as showing A, C, and D on one straight horizontal line, with E below C and segment EC drawn vertically. Ray CB lies inside angle ACE, splitting it into angle 2 between AC and CB and angle 1 between CB and CE. From the text, EC is an altitude of triangle AED, so EC is perpendicular to AD. Since AC is part of AD, angle ACE is 90 degrees. Therefore angle 1 plus angle 2 equals 90: (2x + 7) + (3x + 13) = 90. Solve for x, then substitute into m angle 2 = 3x + 13.

推理：因为 EC 是三角形 AED 的高，所以 EC 垂直于 AD。又因为 AC 是 AD 的一部分，所以 ∠ACE = 90°。角 1 和角 2 正好组成 ∠ACE，因此 m∠1 + m∠2 = 90°。代入已知：(2x + 7) + (3x + 13) = 90，得到 5x + 20 = 90，所以 5x = 70，x = 14。于是 m∠2 = 3x + 13 = 3(14) + 13 = 42 + 13 = 55。
